{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-nf3m","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: edhoc module broken with 54 compile errors under --features edhoc","description":"Code review of commit 80863851 found that the `edhoc` module in `lichen-oscore` fails to compile with 54 errors when the `edhoc` feature is enabled (`cargo check -p lichen-oscore --lib --features edhoc`).

The commit intends to fix CBOR encoding in transcript_2 and transcript_4 per RFC 9528, but:
1. The fix is incomplete — the responder path in `finish_process_message_3` (line 1341) still calls `transcript_4` with 3 arguments (th_3, plaintext, credential) but the function was changed to take 2 (th_3, ciphertext_3).
2. `build_context_2` (line 849) was changed to take 2 args but the old 4-arg version still exists, causing duplicate definition errors and mismatched call sites.
3. Multiple functions are missing: `parse_bstr`, `encode_identifier`, `raw_key_credential`, `parse_suites_r`, `parse_identifier`, `parse_id_cred`, `strong_verifying_key`, `validate_peer_credential`, `append_cbor_bstr`, `encode_credential`, `encode_id_cred`, `poison` method.
4. Types `PendingMessage2` and `PendingMessage3` are not defined.
5. Conflicting `Zeroize` implementations (derive + manual impl).
6. Duplicate imports of `CryptoRng` and `RngCore`.
7. Connection ID type changed from `ConnectionId` to `u8` but call sites still use `.as_bytes()` on plain u8.

The Python counterpart (`python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py`) appears to have the correct fix applied (CBOR encoding in transcript_2 on both initiator and responder sides).

Test vectors in `transcript_2` and `transcript_4` tests were updated to new values. The end-to-end integration test (`EdhocInitiator::new_with_rng + process_message_2_with_credential`) was removed without replacement.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T19:41:22.577913769Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T19:41:22.577913769Z"}
